name: Universal Adapter Doctrine
canonical_compression: Any external tool, model, API, service, device, runtime, or interface is integrated into AETHIEAOPSYS through authenticated AENET routing, bounded execution scope, validator chains, anchor persistence, and Corp-O continuity logging. Tools do not become the system; they become routed capabilities operating inside system governance.
invariant: The tool never owns continuity. AETHIEAOPSYS owns continuity.
